title: Vegetarian family near Schofields? Every cake here is 100% eggless
summary:
Every cake at Num Num's Riverstone is 100% eggless. Not a menu option. The only kind we make.

For vegetarian families in Schofields, Marsden Park and Box Hill, that removes the question you usually have to ask at the counter: does this one have egg in it? Here, the answer is always no, so there is nothing to check.

The sponge is made without eggs from the start, which is why it stays soft rather than turning dense. 15 flavours, from a 6-inch at $39.99 to a 16-inch at $134.99. Custom designs need 2 days notice.

Collect from Shop 8, Riverstone Shopping Centre, with free parking. Order online today.
